agent_latency.query: timeseries duration = avg(gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration), by: { gen_ai.agent.name }, filter: { matchesValue(gen_ai.provider.name, "google") }
agent_latency.title: Agent invocation duration

client_latency.query: timeseries duration = avg(gen_ai.client.operation.duration), by: { gen_ai.request.model }, filter: { matchesValue(gen_ai.provider.name, "google") }
client_latency.title: Client operation duration

errors.query:
fetch spans
| filter matchesValue(otel.scope.name, "google-antigravity-sdk")
| filter span.status_code == "ERROR"
| summarize count = count()
errors.title: Failed spans

intro.content:
## Google Antigravity monitoring

Agent, tool and step spans from the Antigravity SDK's OpenTelemetry hooks, plus the token usage and duration metrics derived from them by the collector.

[Example](https://github.com/dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-ai-agent-instrumentation-examples/tree/main/ai-coding-agents/antigravity) | [SDK](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-sdk-python)

invocations.query:
fetch spans
| filter matchesValue(otel.scope.name, "google-antigravity-sdk")
| filter gen_ai.operation.name == "invoke_agent"
| summarize count = count()
invocations.title: Agent invocations

prompts.query:
fetch spans
| filter matchesValue(otel.scope.name, "google-antigravity-sdk")
| filter gen_ai.operation.name == "invoke_agent"
| fields timestamp, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.model, gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, duration, trace.id
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 25
prompts.title: Prompts and responses

recent.query:
fetch spans
| filter matchesValue(otel.scope.name, "google-antigravity-sdk")
| fields timestamp, span.name, gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.tool.name, duration, span.status_code, trace.id
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50
recent.title: Recent Antigravity spans

steps.query:
fetch spans
| filter matchesValue(otel.scope.name, "google-antigravity-sdk")
| filter isNotNull(antigravity.step.index)
| summarize count = count(), by: { trace.id }
| summarize avg_steps = avg(count)
steps.title: Steps per turn

tokens_by_model.query: timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), by: { gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.token.type }, filter: { matchesValue(gen_ai.provider.name, "google") }
tokens_by_model.title: Tokens by model

tokens_by_type.query: timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), by: { gen_ai.token.type }, filter: { matchesValue(gen_ai.provider.name, "google") }
tokens_by_type.title: Tokens by direction

tool_latency.query: timeseries duration = avg(gen_ai.execute_tool.duration), by: { gen_ai.tool.name }, filter: { matchesValue(gen_ai.provider.name, "google") }
tool_latency.title: Tool execution duration

tools.query:
fetch spans
| filter matchesValue(otel.scope.name, "google-antigravity-sdk")
| filter gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool"
| summarize count = count()
tools.title: Tool executions

total_tokens.title: Total tokens
